verdict.rationale: Latham & Watkins offers digital tools such as the LathamDrive platform, document generators and glossary apps, so asking whether it ships an official MCP server is a fair question. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server or any agent connectivity. Probes also found no llms.txt and no OpenAPI spec, so there is nothing to credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
